home.hero.title: Find your tech career. Learn it in Burmese and English.
home.hero.subtitle: LANN helps you discover the right technology career, follow a clear learning roadmap, practice with verified free resources, and get unstuck with an AI mentor that never invents answers.
home.careers.title: Explore real tech career paths
home.careers.subtitle: Start with a track that matches how you think and what you enjoy building.
home.journey.title: A learning journey that stays connected
home.journey.subtitle: Every step feeds the next — your roadmap, resources, projects, and AI mentor stay in sync.
home.journey.step1.title: Discover & choose
home.journey.step1.description: Explore careers or take the assessment to find a path that fits.

home.journey.step4.title: Ask your AI mentor

home.journey.step5.title: Track your progress
home.journey.step5.description: Watch your progress update automatically as you complete each step.

home.resources.subtitle: Every resource is checked for quality, language, difficulty, and cost before it's recommended — never invented.

home.projects.subtitle: Projects connect directly to your roadmap stage, so you build what you just learned.
